Livelihoods

Project Kalakaari

Livelihoods for artisan communities, everyday alternatives to plastic.

The challenge

Single-use plastic bags remain a default choice for everyday shopping, adding to urban waste in Delhi.

Artisan skills and the women who hold them often lack access to fair, steady income and organised markets.

Our approach

  • Partner with artisan communities to design and produce canvas bags as a practical alternative to plastic.
  • Create a route to market through the chapter, with proceeds supporting the women who make the products.

What we do

Activities and initiatives

Artisan-made canvas bags

The project team works with artisans to produce canvas bags sold as a sustainable alternative to plastic bags.

Sustainable employment

The project is designed to generate steady employment for underprivileged women through the making and sale of products.

Impact

Outcomes so far — as reported by the chapter

We list only outcomes the chapter has publicly reported. Nothing here is estimated or projected.

20+ women empowered

The chapter reported in 2020 that Kalakaari had generated sustainable employment for over 20 underprivileged women.
